# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `clai-inc` MCP server pointing at Clai's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://app.goclai.com/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with Clai user login and an organization/permission consent screen — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: references Clai's hosted image URL; a local `assets/logo.png` still needs to be added.
